parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.external_id AS media_id, t.access_token FROM posts p, tokens t WHERE p.platform = 'instagram' AND p.status = 'published' AND t.platform = 'instagram' AND COALESCE(t.access_token, '') <> '' AND p.posted_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND COALESCE(p.external_id, '') <> '' ORDER BY p.posted_at DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT json_build_object(
  'funnel', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM scripts GROUP BY status) x),
  'income_7d', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commission),0) FROM conversions WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'),
  'income_30d', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commission),0) FROM conversions WHERE ts >= now() - interval '30 days'),
  'orders_7d', (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM conversions WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'),
  'posts_7d', (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM posts WHERE posted_at >= now() - interval '7 days'),
  'posts_by_platform', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT platform, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM posts WHERE posted_at >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY platform) x),
  'avg_score_7d', (SELECT ROUND(AVG(ai_score),1) FROM scripts WHERE ai_score IS NOT NULL AND updated_at >= now() - interval '7 days'),
  'drop_rate_pct', (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('dropped','failed')) / COUNT(*), 1) END FROM scripts),
  'post_metrics', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT s.track, pm.likes, pm.comments, pm.plays, pm.saves, pm.shares, p.posted_at FROM post_metrics pm JOIN posts p ON p.id = pm.post_id JOIN scripts s ON s.id = p.script_id WHERE pm.fetched_at >= now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY pm.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 30) x),
  'active_strategy', (SELECT json_build_object('version', version, 'changes', changes, 'health', health_score) FROM strategy WHERE active = true ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),
  'top_products', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT title, score, status FROM products ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5) x)
) AS metrics;
INSERT INTO strategy (version, analysis, changes, hypotheses, health_score) VALUES ((SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 FROM strategy), $1::jsonb, $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb, $4) RETURNING id, version;
